mentions.name: grateful
mentions.description: This social gratitude app lets you write short entries and keep them private or share them with a circle — a small private group of your own making, such as family and close friends. It positions itself as a private Instagram without strangers or ads.
mentions.problem: Mainstream social media is cluttered with strangers and ads; this offers a private alternative like social media used to be.
mentions.audience: Social sharing with family and close friends; personal/private use
mentions.source_excerpt:
